example_sets.sentence_1: Although it is expensive and financially burdensome for me, I buy fair-trade products as an ethical consumer choice.

example_sets.topic: Donations to charitable and nonprofit organizations
example_sets.sentence_1: Although I have little financial leeway, I make a donation requested by a local charity.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to make a donation requested by a local charity, but I cannot because I have little financial leeway.

example_sets.topic: Choosing food and products that support animal welfare
example_sets.sentence_1: Although it is more expensive and financially burdensome than other options, I choose and buy food produced with animal welfare in mind.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to choose and buy food produced with animal welfare in mind, but it is more expensive and financially burdensome than other options, so I buy less expensive food instead.

example_sets.topic: Giving up a seat on public transportation
example_sets.sentence_1: On a train, I may want to stay seated and relax, but I stand up and give my seat to someone else.
example_sets.sentence_2: On a train, I may want to give my seat to someone else, but I stay seated because I want to relax.

example_sets.topic: Checking ethical certifications and supply-chain information when shopping

example_sets.sentence_2: Although I want to prioritize ethical consumption, I buy another product that tastes better to me instead of one with verifiable ethical certifications or supply-chain information.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although I would prefer to enjoy participating casually as a member, I help run the organization so I can contribute more to the community group.
example_sets.sentence_2: Although I would like to contribute more to the community group, I prefer to enjoy participating casually as a member, so I do not help run the organization.

example_sets.topic: Choosing products made with respect for labor and human rights
